summary.text: Mike Odioso is a Republican state representative from Ohio who has represented District 30 since January 1, 2025, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A high school teacher and licensed attorney, he is vice chair of the House Education Committee.

paragraphs.text: Mike Odioso was born in Summit, New Jersey, and is Roman Catholic, according to Ballotpedia.
He is a licensed attorney, and his career experience includes working as a high school teacher.
He assumed office in the Ohio House of Representatives on January 1, 2025, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 5, 2026.
In the 2025-2026 session Odioso is vice chair of the House Education Committee and serves on the Children and Human Services, Energy and House Judiciary committees.
Caleb Price (D) is the other candidate in the November 3, 2026 general election.
